narrative.summary: The program upgrade authority is a Squads v4 multisig: 5-of-7 voters out of 9 members, with a 12-hour time lock. This is an upper bound: only the program upgrade path is scored, the in-state admin, mint and config authorities are not traced.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10 (first publication of this target). Scored 70 / 100 / 25. The program's upgrade authority is re-read on every run and must equal the offline vault PDA of the named Squads multisig. Both programs share the upgrade authority.

cheapest_fix.what: a confirmed delay before changes apply

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time
